scope: Explicit technical values and representative assembled UI messages. These samples verify display grammar, not every possible user payload or game state.

technical.English: Language selector must retain the language endonym.
technical.VAR BOLD: Font identifier passed through a rendering helper.
technical.II: Roman numeral identifying the second weapon set.
technical./Path of Building/: Literal directory name used in a settings-path example.
technical.base_critical_strike_multiplier: Internal stat identifier, not rendered prose.
technical.height: Control property key, not rendered prose.
technical.label: Control property key, not rendered prose.
technical.Scholar's Platinum Kris of Joy: Copyable English item-parser input example; must retain the original parser language.
